title: delphinium triste var. linearilobum
intro: Delphinium triste var. linearilobum, commonly known as the Delphinium or larkspur, is a perennial plant in the buttercup family native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Delphinium triste var. linearilobum are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include delphinine, delphineine, and chelidonine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
